newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy bourse gives new MIB30 March 6, HPI enters.
newsitem.headline: Italy bourse gives new MIB30 March 6, HPI enters.

text.p: The Italian Stock Exchange will announce on Thursday March 6 the new composition of shares in the blue-chip MIB30 index of Italy's top 30 listed companies, bring the date forward one day from the original March 7 date.
The new basket of shares for the calculation of the index will be still be adopted on March 24.
The Stock Exchange council said Italian industrial holding HPI-Holding di Partecipazioni Industriali SpA will substitute financial holding Gemina in the MIB30 index.
HPI includes most of Gemina's industrial assets and has been spun off from Gemina, and will be quoted on the Milan bourse from March 10.
